clips.title: The story
paras: Along Mirkfallon Lake, Gaea Seeds offer a way to heal Stonetalon's wounded land. Tauren shamans value the hardy kernels for restoring places scarred by war and industry.

Gaea Seeds wash ashore or grow along Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains. Small and fibrous, they look like coconuts, yet endure harsh conditions. As conflict and industry scar the land, shamans see the seeds as a means to heal it.
